{"search_note":"I searched directly for 2024 evidence on `IAEA`, `nuclear safety`, `nuclear security`, `regulatory infrastructure`, `ministerial reshuffle`, `defense`, and `intelligence`.

I did not find a public 2024 case showing Sisi explicitly built an independent expert chain of command for nuclear/security decisions.

I also did not find a 2024 case of overt ideologue control over nuclear policy.

The best evidence is therefore indirect: institutional language, IAEA engagement, and civilian nuclear governance on the positive side, versus repeated retention of trusted insiders in core security posts on the negative side.

Net: the record is somewhat supportive of institution-building, but not strong enough to say Sisi clearly preferred expert insulation over loyalist control in nuclear/security decisions.","evidence":[{"title":"President Sisi swears in new government ministers","publisher":"State Information Service","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://sis.gov.eg/en/media-center/news/president-sisi-swears-in-new-government-ministers/","summary":"Sisi installed a broad new cabinet that included technocratic figures and ministries tied to economic management, energy, science, and foreign affairs.
